summary: Manual checkpoint run (v4-hard, n=5) done → NO-WIN, so the autonomous loop was deliberately NOT wired. Task was genuinely hard (H≈50×W) but the graph didn't collapse hardness (H_on≈H_off, noise) because the recorded verdict was too general for the specific rule; ON paid C=19k overhead → METRIC −16,744. Decision (note-mq731dl2): don't unleash the loop (would null or rig); the checkpoint already answered it. W/H/C framework worked correctly. Only legit follow-up = v4b compounding-memory (near-tautological).
